newsitem.title: USA: Allegheny, DQE merger clears SEC.
newsitem.headline: Allegheny, DQE merger clears SEC.

text.p: Allegheny Power System Inc and DQE Inc said they have received approval of their Form S-4 registration from the Securities and Exchange Commission, allowing them to pursue shareholder approval for the proposed merger that would create Allegheny Energy.
Allegheny Power has scheduled its meeting for 1300 EDT/1700 GMT August 7 in Hagerstown, Md., the companies' joint announcement said.
DQE will conduct its shareholder meeting the same day at 1100 EDT/1500 GMT in Pittsburgh.

The utilities described the SEC approval of the registration statement as the first major hurdle to be cleared by the merger bid. Most of the other regulatory filings, including a filing ot meet the requirements of Pennsylvania's utility restructuring law, will be made about August 1, they said. ((-- New York Newsdesk 212 859-1610))
